title: Removing Parts keeps the inactive Labor person in the one field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active staff member for this test at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Create another active staff member for this test at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep C.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" set to sales rep C and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to the first staff member.
  • Then turn sales rep C's "Sales Representative" switch off and save (the staff account stays active), so Labor reads sales rep C's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One "Sales Representative" field shows, reading sales rep C's name followed by "(Inactive)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-E2: “Removing the Parts field while "Sales Representative - Labor" holds an inactive person keeps that person in the one field, reading "(Inactive)", until someone changes it.”
  • S1-E2: “A person whose Sales Representative switch was turned off, or whose staff account was deactivated, stays in the field until someone changes it. The field reads their name followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)". They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, change-sales-rep rule (section 5, 0.1): “An id the WO already holds is accepted as-is, so an inactive holder can stay, move between sides, or be copied onto Parts when the field is added (S1-E2, S2-E1, S2-R6, S2-E2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
